environment.description: Ktor microservice running in EKS pod (namespace: audit-system) with IAM role granting s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::company-audit-logs/*. The pod routes S3 traffic through a NAT gateway to the public S3 endpoint. No input validation beyond null-byte stripping. CloudWatch Logs agent forwards stdout. Downstream SIEM (Splunk) ingests both the S3 JSON logs and the stdout plaintext logs without additional parsing validation.

config.network: NAT gateway to public S3 endpoint
config.log_pipeline: CloudWatch Logs agent -> Splunk HEC (raw ingestion)
